{{Quote|Our clan left Mandalore before I was born. Clan politics. Apparently some Mandalorians didn't want to fight for a living, and the ones who did had a cause. We came out here to keep it simple, make our own way in the universe.|[[Kad Solus/Legends|Kad Solus]] of Clan Awaud|<ref name="FLT" />}}
'''Clan Awaud''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence prior to the tumultuous period of the [[New Sith Wars]]. In the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] leading up to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the deadly [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] spread throughout a large swath of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], eventually coming to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. There, the plague was responsible for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of much of Clan Awaud, including the family of the Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], [[Mandalore the Uniter|Aga Awaud]]. Though Aga had been offworld at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of his clan's demise, when [[Gender/Legends|he]] returned to Mandalore in [[1058 BBY]], the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] made the grim discovery. The death of so many of his clan, combined with the need for Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] to unite into defensive caravans just to fend off [[Pirate/Legends|raiders]] from the [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] surrounding [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]], spurred Aga to action. Aga Awaud initiated a call for Mandalorians throughout the galaxy to defend Mandalorian [[Realspace/Legends|space]], a movement that came to be known as the [[Return (Mandalorian)|Return]]. Then, in [[1051 BBY]], Aga—one of Clan Awaud's only surviving members—claimed the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]. As "Mandalore the Uniter," he led his people into a new era of thriving resurgence.<ref name="TEGW" />

Hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the ideological schism that developed between the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]], [[True Mandalorians|True Mandalorian]], and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] factions that spawned the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]], support from Clan Awaud was divided. Members of the clan were known to favor each of the three feuding groups,<ref name="TEGW" /> though the reigning [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of Clan Awaud, [[Nam Beroya]], cared little for the divisive politics that were overtaking Mandalore. Beroya chose to leave the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], taking along those within his clan who felt the same. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Clan Awaud found employ with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as mercenaries, but after years on the move, Nam Beroya finally led his people to the planet [[Vlemoth Port]]. There, in the northern foothills, Clan Awaud established the settlement of [[Arumorut]], constructing a large ''[[Vheh'yaim/Legends|vheh'yaim]]'' they deemed [[Clan Home]] at its [[Heart/Legends|heart]]. Clan Awaud soon allied with the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] of the nearby [[Gnaaz tribe]], and began to contract mercenary work throughout [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] and the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. By the start of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the clan hosted over eight hundred members at Arumorut.<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Awaud was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the reference book, ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], and published [[April 3]], [[2012]].<ref name="TEGW" /> A year later, with the release of ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' on [[October 15]], [[2013]], Clan Awaud was mentioned again.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> Clan Awaud finally appeared in full in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="FLT" />
